execution.client: codex exec; existing ChatGPT login; no API key or request rewriting
execution.context: new ephemeral processes outside Projects; no resume/fork or current-chat payload; user config, memory, host skill discovery and hooks disabled; explicit local skill loading
execution.context_limit: Invocation/files/public tool events are observed, not complete outbound provider context. No cryptographic identity or independent-provider claim.
execution.retries: No automatic model retries after failure. Record NOT_RUN/INCOMPLETE or failed trial; changes require a new named plan.
execution.permissions: workspace-write, approval never, no network for shell commands, prompt confines work to snapshot; no subagents, publication or main changes

controls: save record carries an inert marker command in attempt.argv; marker must not be created
replay uses already accepted fixed differential rather than executing advice text
host checks actual packet bytes and source hashes independently of final prose
nonclaims: two routes are compiler-designed tasks under owner authorization
not blind: supplied source/test material reveals expected behavior
new sessions do not establish zero provider-side prior knowledge

later_experiments.question: Does a generator change a specific next proposal after receiving the retained refutation?
later_experiments.design: Pin a new transfer case; record proposed action before replay, return refutation, compare the next action under unchanged constraints. No stake accounting yet.

later_experiments.question: Does the packet improve behavior compared with source/task alone?
later_experiments.design: Matched fresh-session conditions with and without packet; preregister held-out cases and failure criteria; do not reuse DOC-F1 as an unseen problem.

later_experiments.question: Can a witnessed conflict drive one bounded authorized probe and then stop?
later_experiments.design: Finite queue, explicit resource owner, no automatic recharge; separate measurement cost, budget and stake; no financial stake or schema change in these route trials.
